title: Concrete Subtype Schema Field Duplication
pattern: Duplicating core entity attributes in separate structs/tables that represent subtypes of a shared logical concept.
why_bad: Global updates or queries (e.g., "get names of all players") must query multiple distinct structures and synchronize changes individually across all layout definitions.
detection: Distinct structs sharing exact matches of multiple core fields while representing concrete implementations of a single domain concept.
counterexample: Completely unrelated domain types that happen to share standard metadata fields (e.g., `created_at`).
source: *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture*, "Concrete Table Inheritance", p. 298.
